text: きみなら　かわいがって　くれそうだし　ラプラスも　よろこぶ　だろう！

structure.jp: かわいがって　くれそうだし
structure.en: you look like you'd take loving care of it, and

structure.jp: ラプラスも　よろこぶ　だろう！

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: かわいがって　くれそうだ
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form says someone does the thing as a kindness to the speaker's side. かわいがって　くれそうだ = 'you seem like you'd take loving care of it for us'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そうだ stuck onto a verb stem means 'looks like it will'. くれそうだ = 'looks like you would do it for us'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end of a statement gives one reason and hints there are more, like 'and what's more'. かわいがって　くれそうだし = 'you look like you'd take good care of it, and besides'.
